i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issues #303-306, the #142 archive (resolved understanding, ADR 0008), and the latent_power loss/config/training + gold_cycle report code. Record pass when loaded.

q-scope.title: Bundling 4 issues into one bounded run
q-scope.imperative: Is it coherent to knock out #303-306 in one Commander run?
q-scope.finding: YES, bounded. #303 (target_mode removal) + #305 (term-B nu knob) are concrete code. #304 phase-1 (|r/sigma| instrumentation) is an extend+surface job (p95/p99 last-batch telemetry already exists in training.py). #304 phase 2-3 (nu sweep) + #306 (race-start corr flip) are research that terminate in a written verdict, not guaranteed code fixes. Shared foundation: instrumentation (G2) feeds both research gates; single gold-report schema bump covers #303 + #304.

q-branch.title: Branch base
q-branch.imperative: Fresh branch off origin/main or continue on merged #142 branch?
q-branch.finding: DECIDED: fresh branch off origin/main. Created codex/sigma-calibration-followups from origin/main (8b4a8dc, includes #307/#142 merge).

q-retrain.title: Gold retrain appetite
q-retrain.imperative: Conditional, none, or always retrain at the end (~56 min/cycle)?
q-retrain.finding: DECIDED: ALWAYS retrain at the end to refresh the baseline, regardless of whether G4 recommends a default change. G5 runs one full gold cycle with the chosen settings (changed defaults if G4 recommends them, else unchanged), Brier-primary vs current promoted baseline, promote artifacts.

q-schema.title: Gold report schema versioning
q-schema.imperative: Single or double schema bump for target_mode removal + |r/sigma| fields?
q-schema.finding: DECIDED: single bump REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION 4->5 covering BOTH target_mode removal (#303) and the new |r/sigma| percentile report fields (#304). G1 owns the v5 schema contract (removes target_mode + declares |r/sigma| fields); G2 populates the |r/sigma| fields. Producers + committed consumers + gold_report_schema.py doc move together (ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT report-schema rule).

q-depth.title: Research depth / bounding
q-depth.imperative: Verdict-only or chase tuning to a tuned default?
q-depth.finding: DECIDED: bounded. G4 terminates #304 nu tuning and #306 race-start each in a written verdict + recommendation. Deep per-(phase,scope) nu tuning, if indicated, is spun into a fresh follow-up rather than chased in this run. G4 may recommend a single bounded default change (e.g. term-B nu) that G5 then bakes into the retrain.

q-success.title: Success criterion
q-success.imperative: What defines done for this run?
q-success.finding: Done = (a) target_mode concept fully removed, schema v5, suites green (#303); (b) |r/sigma| percentile instrumentation surfaced in module diagnostics + gold report with baseline capture (#304 p1); (c) optional term-B nu knob landed, backward-compatible, tested (#305); (d) written verdicts for nu sensitivity (#304) and race-start corr flip (#306) with recommendations; (e) one full gold retrain with chosen settings, Brier-primary no-regression vs promoted baseline, artifacts promoted; (f) ADR 0008 + packets reconciled; (g) issues #303-306 closed with evidence.

consolidation.summary: Bundle follow-ups #303-306 into one bounded Commander run on fresh branch codex/sigma-calibration-followups (off origin/main). Gates: G1 target_mode removal + schema v5 (#303); G2 |r/sigma| percentile instrumentation surfaced into diagnostics + gold report v5 fields + baseline capture (#304 phase 1); G3 optional term-B nu knob student_t_nu_sigma, backward-compatible, wired latent_power+CLI+gold (#305); G4 bounded research -> written verdicts: nu sensitivity sweep on >=2 module families (#304 p2-3) + race-start corr-flip root cause via per-pair sigma export / robust stats / lambda sweep (#306); G5 ALWAYS one full gold retrain with chosen settings, Brier-primary vs promoted baseline, promote, ADR 0008 + packet reconcile, close #303-306. Protected intent: Student-t heavy-tail robustness (nu>2), mu objective unchanged (term B detaches mu), latent_power must not import evo (ADR 0001), one canonical path, Brier primary for gold comparison, deep per-(phase,scope) nu tuning deferred to a fresh follow-up.
